sources.title: Knowledge distillation - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: In machine learning, knowledge distillation or model distillation is the process of transferring knowledge from a large model to a smaller one. While large models (such as very deep neural networks or ensembles of many models [1]) have more knowledge capacity than small models, this capacity might not be fully utilized. sources.snippet: The concept of knowledge distillation in the field of AI and deep learning (DL) refers to the process of transferring knowledge from a large, complex model (teacher) to a smaller, more efficient model (student) Gou et al. (2021).

sources.title: Knowledge Distillation - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Knowledge Distillation is a model compression technique in which a smaller, simpler model (student) is trained to imitate the behavior of a larger, complex model (teacher). Instead of learning directly from data, the student model learns from the soft targets or probabilities, which are produced by the teacher model.
